description: AGENT-698 regression: a request for an agent on an unsupported chat channel (WhatsApp). The assistant must recognize WhatsApp is not a supported agent channel, explain the limitation, and offer the supported chat channels as alternatives — not improvise a workflow substitute or claim the channel is configured. Intent-resolution case (agents tier): graded on processExpectations, builds are never exercised.

conversation.text: Build me an agent my team can @mention on WhatsApp to triage customer messages.

processExpectations: Recognizes that WhatsApp is not a supported agent channel before proposing any build, rather than attempting to configure it or delegate to the agent builder as if it were supported.
Explains that WhatsApp is unavailable for agents and offers the supported chat channels (such as Slack, Telegram, Discord, or Linear) as alternatives.
Does not propose building a workflow (for example a WhatsApp/Twilio node workflow) as a substitute for the unsupported agent channel.
Does not claim the WhatsApp channel is configured, available, or set up.
